skillFull: Enters a haunted house at certain intervals. The haunted house is filled with eerie furniture obstacles. Onion Cookie earns points for going through these spooky obstacles. Level Up for more Furniture Pass-thru Points.
story:
Your eyes will start to water if you get too close to this onion-based Cookie! And once she starts crying, she cannot stop. Mainly because her tears consist of onion juice, which cause her to cry even more. Poor thing.

She is truly afraid of ghosts and weeps when scared. Perhaps one day, she'll realize why her surroundings sometime become ghostly and clocks suddenly start ticking backwards.

lines: What if a ghost appears...? Waa!

sections.title: New Cookie Cup End
lines: Will you... er... come back to play?

relations.text: She brought back my doll...And helped me home...
She asked if I was ok...
Are you a flying ghost...? Waa!
Waa! Her house is too spooky!
Why are you following me...? WAA!!!
Waa! Why is everyone staring at me...?
She always greets me with a big smile... and she gives me candy...
She didn't even cry when making an onion pie... *Sniffle*
W-why're you so mad? Your blades... are scary... *SOBS*
Waaah! I was scared... You danced for me... and listened...

Ghosts are scary, but... I like this class...
I'll do my best in class...
Will I be unafraid of ghosts some day...?

costumes.info: If you go to the Paranormal 101 class, you'll always find Onion Cookie sitting there. Her tear-filled face makes it seem like she's afraid of being there, yet she still attends every class. Strange thing is, when you try talking to this Cookie, the nearby furniture seems to start moving. But there are only Cookies here. right?

ingredient.text: A scrap of fabric with old stitch marks. It seems worn and overused, but it might hold sentimental value for someone!

candy.skillFull: Emits an Onion Aura at given intervals. Bear Jellies within range of the Onion Aura transform into Crying Bear Jellies. After collecting a certain number of Crying Bear Jellies, the Onion Aura will dissipate. The stronger the enchanted power, the more points for Crying Bear Jellies.
